'''Graata''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] operating during the [[Galactic War]]. His servant [[Treemo]] traveled to [[Voss]], where he asked an Imperial to procure him [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] weapons, to be reproduced and manufactured by Graata.
